title: A Telegram-originated turn completes but its final answer never reaches Telegram, which shows only "turn complete"
outcome: Every turn started from a Telegram message ends with the session's final answer delivered to that Telegram conversation, or a visible, actionable delivery-failure notice there. The outbound delivery attempt and its result are recorded and correlated with the session, conversation and turn.
acceptance: Diagnose, with source locators and the host's logs or records for this occurrence, why session-6219's final answer after the Telegram message "Ok. Co dalej?" (about 20:58 local, 2026-10-08 = 03:58Z 2026-10-09) wasn't delivered, while Telegram showed "turn complete" at 20:57. Say whether the restart at 03:54:38Z (Telegram bridge reconnect) is involved.
The outbound final-delivery event and its result (sent, failed with reason, or skipped with reason) are persisted and correlated with the session, the Telegram conversation and the turn.
A completed turn whose final answer wasn't delivered produces a visible Telegram notice with the reason, never a bare "turn complete"; a test covers the failure path.
